s: Zeman hanachat hattepillin ubo g' seipim: gadol sekar mitzvat tepillin. Vekol mi sheeno menichan — hare hu biklal poshee yisrael begupan. Veap im nimna mippene shetztzerikim gup naqi veshemma lo yizzaher biqdushshatan — abera hi beyado, shebbishat qeriat shema utepilla al kol panim, beqal yukal lizzaher. Veshanu chakamim: leyom haddin, im yihyeh zakkay bemitzvat tepillin — kap zekut makraat, veim pasha bahen — kap choba makraat, sheen leka gedola bekol mitzvot aseh shebbattora yoter mimmitzvat tepillin, shehuqqesha kol hattora kullah litpillin, shenneemar: "lemaan tihyeh torat Hashem bepika", lekak tzarik kol adam sheyyehe zahir bemitzvat tepillin. Vekol hazzahir bahen — maarik yamim:

Mitzvatan lihyot alayv kol hayyom. Abal mippene shetztzerikim gup naqi shello yapiach bahen, vetzarik shello yassiach dato mehem al derek shennitbaer besiman kach, veen kol adam yakol lizzaher bazeh — nahagu shello lahanichan kol hayyom. Umikkol maqom, tzarik kol adam lizzaher bahen lahanichan bishat qeriat shema utepilla (shehare beotah shaa beal korcho hu nizhar mehapiach vehessach haddaat beinyan shennitbaer besiman kach):

Qatan hayyodea lishmor tepillin betohora, shello yapiach bahen, veshello lishon bahem, veshello yikkanes bahen lebet hakkisse apillu liqtannim — chayyab abiv liqnot lo tepillin lechanneko bemitzvot. Veyesh mi sheomer sheqqatan zeh hu ben y"g shana veyom echad, ella shello hebi b' searot, abal pachot mikken — en bo daat lishmor tepillayv, veen mechannekin oto bahen. Veken nahagu bimdinot ellu miqqedem. Veakshav nohagim lechanneko b' veg' chodashim qodem hazzeman:
